So, it gets pretty boring to be alone, collecting clan invitations from people you don't even know... I think it's time for me to settle somewhere.

The problem is, I only found two types of clans so far.

1) Those random clans made by common players, who try to invite everyone they meet, who aren't really active on the community... Those aren't serious clans, most of them don't use english as the main language, and ... I don't know, I feel like those kind of clans can die out after a few weeks, so they aren't really interesting.

2) Clans made by "pro" players, who want their members to get high-end gear, an impressive ratio, teamspeak or mumble, etc.
Clans like that are focused on competition rather than gaming, and it's against my play style. So they're not for me.

I'm looking for this unique clan, that reunites decent players and good spirit. Something that looks more or less like this :

*English as the main language.
*Something like 60-65% of K/D, but only as a recommended ratio, not a required one. Which means they wouldn't mind recruiting someone with 12% of ratio.
*No one would care about how many armor of tokens you have. P2W is one way to play, fighting naked is another. Both deserve respect.
*Skype or teamspeak as a bonus, not as a requirement.
*Being active in the clan chat would be the only rule to respect in this clan.
*Being active on this forum would also be great.
*Clan members wouldn't only talk to each other, but also play with each other.
*Clan wars as an option. Members of that clan could fight and win wars, but choose not to compete too often.
*Maybe a clan forum would be nice.
*little to no competition between members. clanmates are brothers in arms, not rivals.
*Also, they would try to establish an almost permanent clan room, where you play maps made by the clan members. When I say permanent, I say that one member hosts a clann room, then another member hosts a second clan room when the first host has to leave, in order to keep one room most of the time. You can't run dedicated rooms on this game, which is a shame, but workarounds exist. I know this isn't really convenient, but even if the said clan room runs only 2 hours a day, it's perfect.

And that's all that comes to mind. I know I'm asking a lot, but if a clan meets at least half of these, That's good enough for me. At least for a tryout. If I can't find what I'm looking for, I'll save some points and make my own clan, although I'm more of a right-hand man than a leader.

Well, that's it. if you know of a clan that fits the description, please let me know. And tell your friends about me ^^
